Fastbloom

Track intermittent fasts, water, weight, protein and GLP-1 doses, with a weekly recap written on your iPhone. No account and no server: your fasting and health logs stay on your device.

Struggling with food or eating? Free, confidential help is available: in the US or Canada call or text 988 if you are in crisis; elsewhere see findahelpline.com. Eating-disorder helplines.
